title: Comercial en Fletes México, S.A. de C.V.
description: Comercial en Fletes México, S.A. de C.V. (widely recognized by its initials CFM) is a highly established regional leader in the federal freight transport and large-scale logistics sector. Headquartered in Villahermosa, Tabasco, the company proudly operates as a 100% Tabasqueña enterprise, combining deep regional expertise with a robust family-owned corporate culture that spans over five decades of operational history.
